privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ParaRotam ("the app", "we") is a personal finance tracking app. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights. Questions: {{contact}}
privacy.s1_p1: Account info: first name, last name, email, username.
privacy.s1_p2: Authentication: if you sign in with Google / Apple, the identifier (sub) and email from that provider.
privacy.s1_p3: Financial records you enter: transactions, budgets, goals, debts, investments, categories and notes.
privacy.s1_p4: Receipt scan (optional): receipt images you upload are processed only to extract text.
privacy.s1_p5: Push token for notifications; basic technical logs (IP, error logs).
privacy.s2_p1: To create your account and let you sign in.
privacy.s2_p2: To store, summarize and report the financial data you enter (dashboard, budgets, exports).
privacy.s2_p3: To send email verification, password resets and family invites.
privacy.s2_p4: For security, abuse prevention and improving the service.
privacy.s3_p5: Receipt OCR: Google Gemini (only for the receipt image you upload).
privacy.s3_p6: We NEVER sell your data or share it for advertising.
privacy.s4_p1: We keep your data while your account is active.
privacy.s4_p2: You can permanently delete your account and all data in-app via "Delete my account"; deletion is irreversible.
privacy.s5_p1: You may access, correct, delete your data and object to processing.
privacy.s5_p2: You can export your data as PDF/Excel (portability).
privacy.s6_p1: Connections are encrypted with HTTPS; passwords are stored irreversibly; sessions use JWT.
privacy.s6_p2: No system is 100% secure, but we apply reasonable technical and organizational measures.
privacy.s7_p1: The app is not directed to children under 13.
privacy.s8_p1: We may update this policy; significant changes will be announced in-app or by email.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using ParaRotam you agree to the following terms.
terms.s1_p1: ParaRotam is a tool to track your personal and family finances. It does not link to banks or move real money.
terms.s2_p1: You are responsible for your account credentials and the activity on your account, and agree to provide accurate information.
terms.s3_p1: You may not use the app for unlawful purposes, to violate others' rights, or to abuse the system.
terms.s4_p1: ParaRotam is a tracking tool; it does NOT provide investment, tax or financial advice. Decisions are your responsibility. Rate/price data comes from third parties and may be delayed/approximate.
terms.s5_p1: The app and its content belong to ParaRotam. The data you enter belongs to you.
terms.s6_p1: The service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages.
terms.s7_p1: You may delete your account in-app at any time. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s8_p1: We may update these terms; the current version is published on this page.
terms.s9_p1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye.

support.title: Support
support.intro: We are here to help with any question, bug report or suggestion about ParaRotam. Browse the frequently asked questions below, or email us directly.
support.contactBody: You can email us about anything — your account, subscription, your data, or how the app works. Including your device (iPhone/Android/web) and a short description of the issue helps us respond faster.
support.responseTime: We reply to every message within 48 hours.
support.faq1_q: I forgot my password, what should I do?
support.faq1_a: Use the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in screen. We will send a reset link to your email address. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder or contact us.
support.faq2_q: How do I delete my account and data?
support.faq2_a: In the app, go to Profile → Delete my account. Your account and all financial data are permanently deleted; this cannot be undone. You can export your data first if you wish.
support.faq3_a: Yes. From the Exports screen you can download your transactions and reports as PDF or Excel.
support.faq4_q: How do I cancel my premium subscription?
support.faq4_a: Subscriptions are managed through the App Store / Google Play. On iPhone: Settings → your Apple ID → Subscriptions; on Android: Play Store → Profile → Payments & subscriptions. After cancelling, premium features stay active until the end of the billing period.
support.faq5_q: How do family (shared budget) invites work?
support.faq5_a: From the Family screen you create and share an invite link. When the invited person opens the link and accepts, they join your shared budget and you see family-scoped records together.
support.faq6_q: How does receipt scanning work — are my photos stored?
support.faq6_a: A receipt photo is processed only to extract the amount and line items as text. See the Privacy Policy page for details.

deleteAccount.title: Account & data deletion
deleteAccount.intro: You can permanently delete your ParaRotam account and all data associated with it at any time. This page describes the available deletion methods, as required by Google Play and App Store policies.
deleteAccount.step1: Sign in to the ParaRotam app.
deleteAccount.emailBody: If you can no longer access the app, send us an email titled "account deletion" from your registered email address. We process requests within 48 hours and notify you once the deletion is complete.
deleteAccount.item1: Your account details (name, email, sign-in credentials)
deleteAccount.item2: All your financial records (transactions, budgets, goals, investments, debts)
deleteAccount.item3: Receipt photos you uploaded and your export history
deleteAccount.subscriptionNote: Important: deleting your account does NOT automatically cancel your App Store / Google Play subscription. To stop recurring charges, also cancel the subscription in your store account (iPhone: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions; Android: Play Store → Profile → Payments & subscriptions). Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone; you may export your data from the Exports screen beforehand.
